reason: The patch changes the 413 branch of displayErrorForUpload so it always reports 10 * 1024 KB (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/lib/utilities.js:246); before, it used Discourse.SiteSettings.max_image_size_kb. A 413 comes from the web server, whose limit an admin can set lower (docs/INSTALL-ubuntu.md:390 uses client_max_body_size 2m), so the message can state a wrong limit.
